description_en: Queries the access count for a specific table or all tables in an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster on a specified date
description_zh: 查看指定日期内AnalyticDB MySQL版集群下目标表或所有表的被访问次数
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-table-access-count --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --start-time 2021-08-30 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTableAccessCount

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the target table.

If you leave this parameter empty, data on the access frequency of all tables in the cluster for the specified date is returned
parameters.help_zh:
目标表名。
若该参数留空，则会返回当前日期内目标集群下所有表的使用频次数据
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The date to query. Use the yyyy-MM-dd format. The time is in UTC.

You can query data from the last 30 days only
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd（UTC时间）。 仅支持查看30天内的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule for the query results. The value is a JSON string. Example: `[{"Field":"TableSchema","Type":"Asc"}]`. The JSON string contains the following fields:

`Field`: The field used for sorting. Valid values:

`TableSchema`: The name of the database.

`TableName`: The name of the table.

`AccessCount`: The number of times the table was accessed.

`Type`: The sorting type. Valid values:

`Asc`: Ascending order.

`Desc`: Descending order.

If you do not specify this parameter, the results are sorted in ascending order by the database name
parameters.help_zh:
将查询结果按指定字段进行排序。格式为JSON字符串，例如`[{"Field":"TableSchema","Type":"Asc"}]`。其中：
`Field`表示排序字段。支持如下取值：
    - `TableSchema`：表所属的数据库名。
    - `TableName`：表名。
    - `AccessCount`：表被访问的次数。
`Type`表示排序方式。支持如下取值：
    - `Asc`：升序排序。
    - `Desc`： 降序排序。

若不设置参数，默认按照目标表所属的数据库升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值为任意正整数。默认为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the available regions and zones of AnalyticDB for MySQL, including the region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AccessCount.description_en: The number of times the table was accessed

InstanceName.description_en: The ID of the cluster to which the table belongs

TableSchema.description_en: The database to which the table belongs

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries on the current page
